subject: Executive workshop — CedarPoint: staging, travel corridors, VIP logistics
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@cedarpoint.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@cedarpoint.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Draft plan for CedarPoint exec workshop (Sept 14-15)

Hi team —

Following our sync with CedarPoint last week, attached is a working draft of the onsite plan for the two-day exec workshop. High-level asks from their side:
- Day 1: executive product demo + metrics deep-dive (AM), breakout ops sessions (PM)
- Day 2: runbook + migration readiness + executive wrap (half-day)

Open coordination items before we lock travel and hotel blocks:
1) Confirm headcount for Redwood onsite (we currently show 4: Marcus, Olga, Jasmine, Grace).
2) VIP escort — CedarPoint requested an on-site escort for the CEO during Day 1 lunch and Day 2 arrival. Need scope.
3) AV / room layout — CedarPoint expects a 120" screen + hybrid setup for EU leadership dialing in.
4) Hotel blocks & arrival windows — they prefer staggered arrivals to avoid congestion at the venue.

Olga / Jasmine: can you confirm staffing and whether we want to bring a solutions engineer for the breakout demos?

Liam / Anika: would you prefer a single venue for both days or split between HQ and a nearby conference center? Also, any restrictions for attendees (travel approvals, building access)?

Attached: workshop-itinerary-v1.pdf (draft).

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@cedarpoint.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft plan for CedarPoint exec workshop (Sept 14-15)

Marcus — thanks for the plan, looks good. A few clarifications from our side:
- Venue: prefer single venue (HQ boardroom + adjacent breakout rooms) to keep execs together. We can open the employee cafeteria for the lunch escort to meet privately.
- Arrival windows: preferred windows are Sept 13 after 2pm and Sept 14 early AM for last-minute arrivals.
- Building access: external vendors need a day pass and photo ID at security desk. We can pre-clear up to 6 external badges.
- VIP escort: we can provide a CedarPoint senior host but would appreciate a brief from Redwood on the escort responsibilities (scheduling, introductions, security lane).

We do have an exec conflict on Sept 15 late morning; can we compress the Day 2 wrap to end by 1:00pm PT?

I'll loop Anika on logistics and provide hotel suggestions.

Best,
Liam
Liam Chen
Director, Strategic Programs | CedarPoint Financial
liam.chen@cedarpoint.com
(415) 555-7423

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-26T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft plan for CedarPoint exec workshop (Sept 14-15)

Thanks Liam — single venue and compressed Day 2 works for us. Quick internal note:
- Confirmed Redwood onsite: Olga (lead), Marcus (AE), Jasmine (CS lead), Grace (solutions engineer) — bringing Grace for the breakout demos as she owns the migration playbooks.
- Travel: we'll propose flight arrivals Sept 13 (preferred) and Sept 14 early AM for any constrained schedules.
- VIP escort: Marcus / Olga to draft a 1-page escort brief; Marcus can share prior template.
- AV: Grace — can you confirm we have the tech checklist for a hybrid 1080p stream and backup dongle options?

I attached the itinerary and a preliminary staff contact list. Also adding a note: procurement will need an invoice address for catering and any vendor badges.

Attached: vip-escort-brief.docx; workshop-itinerary-v1.pdf (copied).

—Olga

- Hotel block: Anika, can you confirm preferred properties (we'll hold 6 rooms Sept 13-15).

If we get these confirmed by EOD Friday (Aug 28), I'll publish provisional calendar holds for Redwood and CedarPoint participants (with tentative rooms).

- Hotel block: prefer the HarborView Hotel (6 rooms held pending release on Aug 31). Please send names & estimated arrival times by Monday (Aug 30).
- Badge pre-clear: we'll need full names and passport/driver's license numbers for non-US citizens; for domestic US travelers, a quick DOB will suffice. We can provide a secure upload link.
- Dietary restrictions: please list any specific needs (we have vegetarian, gluten-free options).
- VIP escort: CedarPoint will assign a senior host. Marcus / Olga — can you confirm the escort brief by EOD Aug 28 so CedarPoint can finalize the senior host's talking points?
